name: Licenses
description: Tracks and displays the site's software license usage information.
project_description:
The Licenses module provides an overview of all declared licenses in a Drupal project and provides an overview page with detailed information.

 This might be needed for Software License Compliance reasons.

 The module currently supports the listing of:

 
 Composer installed dependencies 
 Core, contrib and custom modules 
 Core, contrib and custom themes 
 NPM or Yarn installed packages in themes (without the actual license atm)
